subject: Mathematics
title: Fun with Shapes
subtitle: Circles, triangles and squares all around us
hero_picture: A bright Kerala village scene built from simple shapes: a round orange sun, triangle-shaped trees, a house with a square body and a triangle roof, a boat on a river, and happy children pointing at the shapes.

sections.heading: Round like a dosa
text: Dad is making dosa. Sizzling dosa!
A dosa is round. A bangle is round. The sun is round.
A round shape is called a circle.
sections.caption: Round dosas
sections.picture: A father making round dosas on a pan in a Kerala kitchen, a smiling girl holding a plate of round white dosas.

sections.heading: Three corners
text: A Christmas-tree drawing is made of triangles.
A shape with three sides is a triangle.
sections.caption: Samosa and a triangle tree
sections.picture: A plate of triangle-shaped samosas next to a tall green tree made of three stacked triangles, a girl and a boy pointing at them.

sections.heading: Square and oblong
text: Look at a house. The wall is a square.
The door is long. It is an oblong (rectangle).
A box and a book are oblong too.
sections.caption: A house made of shapes
sections.picture: A small house made of shapes: a square wall, a triangle roof, a rectangle door, and a round sun in the sky.

sections.heading: My robot
text: Join the dots and make a robot.
Round head, square body, long legs.
How many circles can you see on it?
sections.caption: A robot made of shapes
sections.picture: A friendly toy robot made of shapes: a round head, a square body, rectangle legs, triangle hands and circle buttons; two children laughing.

sections.heading: What comes next?
sections.caption: Shape pattern
sections.picture: A neat row of shapes making a pattern on a table: triangle, circle, triangle, circle, triangle, and an empty space at the end; coloured blocks.

rhyme: What is round? A dosa is round!
What has three corners? A samosa, I found!
What is long? A box, a door,
Shapes are everywhere, on the floor!
activity: Find three round things and three oblong things in your house. Draw them.
talk: Name something round in your kitchen.
How many corners does a triangle have?
summary: Circles, triangles, squares and rectangles are all around us.

questions.explanation: A dosa is round, like a circle.

questions.prompt: How many corners does a triangle have?
questions.explanation: A triangle has three sides and three corners.

questions.prompt: Which snack looks like a triangle?

questions.explanation: A door is long, like a rectangle.

questions.prompt: Triangle, circle, triangle, circle, ... What comes next?
questions.explanation: The pattern repeats: after circle comes triangle.
